description: This file provides utility functions for handling module specifiers, inventory comparison, and inventory collection in a project that likely involves TypeScript source code analysis and inventory management.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Normalizes a file path relative to a repository root, converting path separators to forward slashes.

methods.name: resolveRepoSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier to a repository-relative path based on whether it is relative, absolute, or external.

methods.name: visitModuleSpecifiers
methods.description: Traverses a TypeScript source file AST to find import, export, and dynamic import specifiers, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: diffInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventories (expected vs actual) and returns missing and unexpected entries.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a line of text to a given writable stream.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptInventory
methods.description: Collects inventory entries from multiple TypeScript files asynchronously.

methods.name: runBaselineInventoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a baseline comparison between expected and actual inventories, optionally outputting results in JSON or human-readable format.
